notes: Original EffectCraft behavior animation presets (MIT OR Apache-2.0), written from scratch using layer transform keyframes and deterministic expressions. Key times are seconds from the current time.

presets.name: Autoscroll - Horizontal
presets.description: Smooth continuous horizontal movement driven by a time expression.

presets.name: Autoscroll - Vertical
presets.description: Smooth continuous vertical movement driven by a time expression.

presets.name: Rotate Continuously
presets.description: Constant 360-degree rotation over time at 90 degrees per second.

presets.name: Pulse Opacity
presets.description: Gently pulses layer opacity between 40% and 100% in a smooth sine wave.

presets.name: Wiggle - Position
presets.description: Organic random 2D position wiggle at 2 Hz frequency with 35 px amplitude.

presets.name: Wiggle - Scale
presets.description: Organic pulsing scale variation at 3 Hz frequency with 10% amplitude.

presets.name: Scale Bounce In
presets.description: Layer scales up from 0 with an elastic overshoot bounce.

presets.name: Drift and Fade
presets.description: Layer gently drifts upward while fading to transparent over 2 seconds.
